jobs.title: IT & Cybersecurity Specialist Job Miale Solar
jobs.description: IT Jobs, Miale Solar Jobs. IT & Cybersecurity Specialist manages IT infrastructure, network security, and data protection, requires an IT/Computer Science Degree and cybersecurity experience. Full-time role in Nairobi.
responsibilities: As Miale Solar Solutions grows, protecting our systems, networks, user accounts, backups and company data has become a priority alongside organising our data itself. We are recruiting an IT & Cybersecurity Specialist to safeguard the company\’s IT environment from unauthorised access and cyber threats, and to keep our day-to-day IT infrastructure running reliably.

The role is responsible for the practical, hands-on protection of company systems: managing user access and accounts, maintaining backups and recovery procedures, securing networks and devices, and responding to security incidents. The Specialist works closely with the Data & Information Systems Manager, who sets overall data and security standards, to implement and maintain those standards in practice across the business.

Depending on the company’s needs, this role may initially be filled on an outsourced or part-time/retainer basis rather than as a full-time in-house hire; the responsibilities below apply to either arrangement, with scope and hours adjusted accordingly.
requirements: Degree, Diploma or recognised certification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Networking or Cybersecurity (e.g. CompTIA Security+, CCNA, or similar is an advantage).
2-4 years of experience in IT administration, network support or cybersecurity, ideally including small/medium business environments.
Practical experience with firewalls, antivirus/endpoint protection, backup systems and access-management tools.
Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (LAN/WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi security) and common operating systems.
Experience responding to or supporting investigation of security incidents is an added advantage.
jobs.howToApply: Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to:hr@mialesolar.comusing the position as subject of email.
